selection_method: Strict-first ranking within the next 72 hours of the run
rule: one independently quoted market per distinct fixture; strict qualifications first, then up to ten clearly labeled provisional near-miss watchlist candidates
near_miss_policy: PROVISIONAL is not strictly qualified. Only limited historical sample gaps, modest audit overconfidence, or small adjusted probability misses are considered; adjusted EV must remain at least +1.5%; bookmaker sanity, source, timing, team mapping, raw DC probability and raw EV must remain valid.
warning: PROVISIONAL picks explicitly FAILED strict historical or EV requirements and are ONLY an analysis watchlist, not betting recommendations. No validated guaranteed matches or perfect betslips exist; ten-leg accumulators have substantial loss risk.
